title: Design a URL shortener
prompt: Design a service that turns long URLs into short links and redirects visitors to the original page. Users can optionally pick a custom alias and set an expiry.
assumptions: 100M new links per month
Reads outnumber writes 100 to 1
Redirects should feel instant (p99 under 100 ms)
Links are retained for 5 years

title: Design a chat app like WhatsApp
prompt: Design a chat application that supports one-to-one and group messaging with delivery receipts, offline delivery and media sharing.
assumptions: 500M daily active users
Each user sends about 40 messages per day
Online messages are delivered within 500 ms
Groups hold up to 256 members

title: Design a rate limiter
prompt: Design a rate limiter that restricts how many requests a client can make to an API in a given time window across a fleet of servers.
assumptions: 1M requests per second across the fleet at peak
10M distinct clients (API keys or IPs)
Typical rule: 100 requests per minute per client
Limiter adds under 5 ms to a request

title: Design a news feed
prompt: Design a news feed where users see a ranked list of recent posts from people they follow.
assumptions: 300M daily active users
Each user opens the feed about 5 times a day
50M new posts per day
Average user follows 500 accounts, celebrities have up to 50M followers

title: Design a notification service
prompt: Design a notification service that sends push, SMS and email messages to users on behalf of many internal product teams.
assumptions: 1B notifications per day across all channels
Peak traffic is about 5x average
Marketing blasts can target 50M users within 10 minutes
Time-critical messages such as OTP must arrive within 5 seconds

title: Design a video streaming platform
prompt: Design a video streaming platform where creators upload videos and viewers stream them on phones, browsers and TVs.
assumptions: 200M daily active viewers watching about 1 hour each
500k new videos uploaded per day, 10 minutes long on average
Playback should start within 2 seconds
Peak concurrency is about 10% of daily users

title: Design a ride-hailing service
prompt: Design a ride-hailing service that matches riders with nearby drivers, tracks the trip and computes the fare.
assumptions: 10M rides per day
1M drivers online at peak, each sending location every 4 seconds
A rider should be matched within 5 seconds
Ride requests peak at about 5x the daily average

title: Design a file storage and sync service
prompt: Design a file storage and sync service where users keep files in the cloud and see changes synced across their devices.
assumptions: 50M users with about 2 GB stored on average
10M daily active users
Files up to 10 GB, split into 4 MB chunks
Changes should sync to other devices within 10 seconds

title: Design search autocomplete
prompt: Design a search autocomplete system that suggests the top queries as a user types each character.
assumptions: 500M searches per day
Suggestions requested on about 5 keystrokes per search
Suggestions must appear within 100 ms
Top 10 suggestions per prefix

title: Design a web crawler
prompt: Design a web crawler that discovers and downloads pages from the internet for a search engine to index.
assumptions: 1B pages crawled per month
Average page is 100 KB
Pages are recrawled based on how often they change
The crawler must be polite to every site

title: Design a distributed cache
prompt: Design a distributed in-memory cache that application services use to reduce load on their databases.
assumptions: 1M operations per second
5 TB of cached data, average value 1 KB
90% reads and 10% writes
p99 latency under 5 ms

title: Design a distributed key-value store
prompt: Design a distributed key-value store that is highly available and scales horizontally to hundreds of terabytes.
assumptions: 100 TB of data, values of 1 KB on average (up to 10 KB)
500k operations per second
Replication factor 3
99.99% availability

title: Design a ticket booking system
prompt: Design a ticket booking system for events where thousands of users compete for a limited number of seats and no seat may be sold twice.
assumptions: Venue with 50k seats; a hot event draws 500k users
Peak 100k requests per second on the seat map
Seats are held for 10 minutes during checkout
Normal days: 100 events and low traffic

title: Design a payment system
prompt: Design a payment system that lets merchants accept card payments through external payment service providers and keeps accurate financial records.
assumptions: 10M payments per day
Peak around 1,000 payments per second
Money must never be lost or double charged
Financial records retained for 7 years

title: Design a metrics and monitoring system
prompt: Design a metrics and monitoring system that collects metrics from servers, stores them, and supports dashboards and alerting.
assumptions: 100k hosts each emitting 100 metrics every 10 seconds
Alerts should fire within 1 minute of a problem
Keep full-resolution data for 15 days and downsampled for 13 months
Dashboard queries return in under 1 second

title: Design a distributed message queue
prompt: Design a distributed message queue where producers publish messages to topics and consumers read them reliably.
assumptions: 500k messages per second sustained, 1M at peak
Messages average 1 KB
Messages are retained for 3 days
Replication factor 3

title: Design an API gateway
prompt: Design an API gateway that sits in front of many backend services and handles routing, authentication and traffic control for external clients.
assumptions: 50k requests per second at peak
200 backend services
Added latency under 10 ms at p99
99.99% availability

title: Design a real-time leaderboard
prompt: Design a real-time leaderboard for an online game that shows the top players and each player's own rank.
assumptions: 50M players
Up to 100k score updates per second at peak
50k rank lookups per second
Top 100 must reflect scores within 1 second

title: Design a hotel booking system
prompt: Design a hotel booking system where users search for hotels, check room availability for their dates and reserve a room.
assumptions: 500k hotels with a total of 50M rooms
1M bookings per day
Search traffic is 100x bookings
Reservations must never exceed room inventory

title: Design a collaborative document editor
prompt: Design a collaborative document editor where multiple users edit the same document simultaneously and see each other's changes in real time.
assumptions: 10M daily active users
500k concurrent editors at peak, about 1 operation per second each
Remote edits appear within 200 ms
Up to 100 concurrent editors per document, typically 2 to 5

title: Design an LLM chat service
prompt: Design a chat service where users hold conversations with a large language model and see responses streamed token by token.
assumptions: 20M daily active users sending 10 messages each
Average prompt of 2,000 tokens including history and response of 500 tokens
First token within 1 second
Streaming speed of about 50 tokens per second per user

title: Design a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system
prompt: Design a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system that answers questions over a company's private documents using an LLM.
assumptions: 10M documents, about 200M chunks of roughly 500 tokens
500 queries per second at peak
End-to-end answer latency under 4 seconds at p95
New or updated documents searchable within 5 minutes

title: Design a paste sharing service
prompt: Design a paste sharing service where users store snippets of text and share them through a short link.
assumptions: 1M new pastes per day
Reads outnumber writes 10 to 1
Pastes average 10 KB with a 10 MB maximum
Pastes expire after a user-chosen time, default 1 year

title: Design a distributed unique ID generator
prompt: Design a distributed service that generates unique, roughly time-sortable 64-bit IDs for many applications.
assumptions: 100k IDs per second overall, peaking at 1M per second
1,000 application servers need IDs
IDs fit in 64 bits and sort roughly by time
No coordination on the hot path for each ID

title: Design a distributed lock service
prompt: Design a distributed lock service that lets processes on different machines get exclusive access to a shared resource.
assumptions: 100k lock operations per second
1M distinct locks
Default lease of 30 seconds
Acquire latency under 10 ms

title: Design a food delivery platform
prompt: Design a food delivery platform where customers order from restaurants and couriers deliver the food.
assumptions: 5M orders per day with peaks at lunch and dinner about 5x average
500k restaurants and 300k active couriers
Couriers send location every 5 seconds
Delivery in 30 to 45 minutes
